subject: Regional pricing & residency — pilot pricing proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Regional pricing & residency — quick post-call recap

Hi Lena — great chat earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we’re all aligned.

Summary of what we heard (from your side):
- Core usage: ~1.2B tokens / month across product analytics and customer-facing chat.
- Burst pattern: 20% of traffic concentrated in daily morning windows.
- Data residency requirement for EU customers (subset of logs + embeddings) — must remain in EU region.
- Reference budget: budget range is roughly $700k–$1.1M / month spend target for inference (customer expects unit goals, not topline).

Prelim unit economics we discussed (attached estimate):
- Base US unit target: $900 per 1M tokens (target the customer asked about).
- EU uplift: expect ~20–30% delta vs US for EU-resident workloads depending on committed capacity & quantization mix (we estimated ~25% in the spreadsheet).
- Cost levers: committed monthly vCPU/GPU reservations, prefix caching on popular flows, and model quantization (we recommended 8-bit for chat-heavy routes).

Questions / asks for you:
1) Can you confirm the 1.2B tokens/month includes embeddings? If not, split embeddings vs chat (ballpark).
2) How much of that volume must be EU-resident vs acceptable to route via US? (ballpark % is fine)
3) Are you open to a 3–6 month pilot with a PO covering a committed floor to access the lower EU pricing band?

Next steps (suggested):
- We’ll provide a short two-page pilot proposal + SOW and estimated unit-econ workbook by EOD tomorrow (attached: redwood_unit_econ_estimate_v1.xlsx).
- You confirm residency split and whether embeddings are part of the 1.2B metric.
- If aligned, our commercial lead (cc’d) will prepare a pilot PO with tiered pricing for committed tokens and an EU surcharge schedule.

Thanks again — looking forward to closing this out quickly if the numbers align.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri***@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-01 22

[Attachment: redwood_unit_econ_estimate_v1.xlsx]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@finlytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@finlytics.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Regional pricing & residency — quick post-call recap

Thanks for the thorough summary, Priyom. Confirming the numbers from our side:
- The 1.2B tokens/month figure includes both chat and embeddings (roughly 85% chat, 15% embeddings).
- EU residency requirement applies to about 18–22% of traffic today (mainly EU enterprise customers), trending up with expansion.
- Budget: target is to keep unit costs ~ $900 / 1M tokens in the US region; EU budget will accept some premium, but we’d like to keep it under ~$1,200 / 1M if possible.

We are open to a 3-month pilot. Procurement would prefer a PO with a committed floor and a true-up mechanism at the end of the pilot. Can you send a one-page commercial summary + SOW so procurement can review?

Lena Ortiz
Head of Product, Finlytics
lena@finlytics.com | +44 20 7183 0000

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Regional pricing & residency — internal note

Internal note / quick calc:
- If Finlytics is at 1.2B tokens/month (85% chat / 15% embeddings), that is roughly 1.02B chat / 180M embeddings.
- Our blended cost-to-serve estimate (hosted, mixed quantization) ~ $0.6–0.7 per 1k tokens => ~ $600–700 per 1M tokens in US base cost.
- To reach their $900 target we can afford ~20–30% GTM/overhead + margin. EU residency premium at committed scale (monthly floor >= $500k) can be driven down to ~15% delta; without commitment it’s closer to 25–30%.

Recommendation:
1) Offer a 3-month pilot with a committed monthly floor of ~$450k and a layered pricing schedule: base US = $920 / 1M tokens, EU surcharge = +15% (falls to +10% if they convert to annual commit).
2) Include a clause for a one-time migration/ingest credit for EU onboarding (helps procurement justify the PO).

I’ll draft the pilot commercial lines and SOW bullets for the one-pager. We should keep the pilot simple: PO -> committed floor -> monthly true-up with crediting.

Rishi
Sr. Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, procure@finlytics.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot proposal & next steps (SOW + PO path)

Lena — thanks for the quick turnaround and confirming the split. Attached is a two-page pilot proposal and a draft SOW that reflects the committed-floor approach we discussed. Key commercial points (summary):
- Pilot length: 3 months; committed floor: $450,000 / month.
- Pricing: US baseline $920 / 1M tokens; EU surcharge +15% (i.e., ~$1,058 / 1M tokens) during pilot.
- True-up: monthly usage measured, true-up at pilot close with credit toward next contract or refund if over-collected.
- Migration/ingest credit: one-time credit up to $30k to offset EU onboarding effort.

If this looks good, next steps:
1) Sign SOW / issue PO referencing Deal ID DEAL-9876. I’ve included a HubSpot deal link and a DocuSign stub for a standard PO + SOW.
2) We’ll provision EU region-only endpoints for the residency subset and schedule a short kick-off next week with our infra team (2–3 hrs).

Attachments: SOW-draft-Finlytics-v1.pdf, redwood_unit_econ_estimate_v1.xlsx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9876
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/rec/abcdef123456789

Best,
